entities.summary: Daniel D. Barnard was a political leaders in Sheffield (1797-07-16, Sheffield – 1861-04-24), recognized as a landmark figure in the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Shaped political institutions and governance practices.
